title: Network pharmacology-based elucidation of the regulatory mechanism of Solanum lyratum (Bai Ying) against psoriasis via the IL-17A/STAT3 axis: Molecular docking and HaCaT cell validation.
authors: Chen, Zhaoxia; Zhang, Yonghao; Han, Xuyang; Qu, Jianhua; Di, Tingting; Zhang, Guangzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究茄科植物提取物对银屑病IL-17A/STAT3通路的调控，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis affects approximately 2% of the global population, with the IL-17A-STAT3 pathway mediating abnormal keratinocyte proliferation and inflammatory amplification. Solanum lyratum (Bai Ying) has long been used for skin disorders, and its steroidal alkaloids have anti-inflammatory potential, though the mechanisms remain unclear. OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the molecular basis and cytological efficacy of S. lyratum steroidal alkaloids in exerting anti-psoriatic effects via the IL-17A/STAT3 axis. METHODS: HPLC-MS-QTOF, network pharmacology, molecular simulation, and a HaCaT cell model with STAT3-siRNA assays were employed. RESULTS: Eighteen components were identified; steroidal alkaloids showed high affinity for STAT3 and IL17RA. S. lyratum (5-40 mug/mL) enhanced cell viability, inhibited p-STAT3 (IC50 = 14.30 mug/mL), and attenuated inflammatory responses and keratinocyte proliferation. CONCLUSION: S. lyratum steroidal alkaloids exert dual-targeted blocking effects on the IL-17A/STAT3 axis, supporting it as a potential therapeutic candidate for psoriasis.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病影响全球约2%的人口，其中IL-17A-STAT3通路介导角质形成细胞异常增殖和炎症放大。白英（Solanum lyratum）长期用于皮肤病治疗，其甾体生物碱具有抗炎潜力，但机制尚不明确。目的：阐明白英甾体生物碱通过IL-17A/STAT3轴发挥抗银屑病作用的分子基础和细胞学功效。方法：采用HPLC-MS-QTOF、网络药理学、分子模拟以及带有STAT3-siRNA检测的HaCaT细胞模型。结果：鉴定出18种成分；甾体生物碱对STAT3和IL17RA表现出高亲和力。白英（5-40 μg/mL）增强细胞活力，抑制p-STAT3（IC50 = 14.30 μg/mL），并减弱炎症反应和角质形成细胞增殖。结论：白英甾体生物碱对IL-17A/STAT3轴发挥双靶点阻断作用，支持其作为银屑病的潜在治疗候选药物。
